description: Presidential Secretariat - Appoint Commissioners to the Commission of Inquiry Act
reasoning: This gazette establishes a Commission of Inquiry to investigate allegations of corruption and misuse of power. It specifically appoints five named individuals (including retired judges, an auditor general, and a ministry secretary) to serve as commissioners. The content focuses on judicial/law enforcement matters - establishing an investigative commission with legal authority to conduct inquiries, collect evidence, and make recommendations for criminal proceedings. This falls under judicial/law enforcement appointments and investigative procedures rather than general government personnel changes.
